race.comment: ZOUPER FUND (8) is yet to strike through this prep but is knocking on the door and gets his chance to strike. Rock-hard fit now and gets in a treat with Williams' 2kg claim. Ready. TORNADO EXPRESS (12) is ticking along in good order and sets up well for this down on the minimum. Should land in a handy spot behind the early pace and prove a handful to hold out at the featherweight. It's worth forgiving SIR ARTIE (1) after getting way too far back at Rosehill last time. His three prior runs are all capable of taking this out and Houston's claim helps. HOPPER (10) flashed home fresh at Eagle Farm, then got the job done stylishly at the Sunny Coast second up. Was left with too much to do last time back at EF but was strong to the line. The rise in trip looks perfect for him fourth up. BLAZING HARRY (7) knuckled down strongly to stick his neck out and reward supporters here last time. Keeps Youngberry's claim and gets his chance to repeat the dose.
